instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the royal purple branding (#581C87 / #3B0764 / #FAF5FF) and gold/amber highlights (#F59E0B) as requested. Do not change the logo or the brand tagline 'Trusted by Families, Students & Offices Since Day One'.
Replace any generic graphics with provided high quality photography URLs from unsplash/pexels in this guideline.
Implement real products with Indian brands: Classmate, Navneet, DOMS, Camlin, Apsara, Nataraj, Cello, Reynolds, Faber-Castell, Kangaro, Casio, Solo, JK Paper.
Every product card must show: Product Image, Product Name, Category, Starting Price (₹), and 'Available In Store' badge with quick WhatsApp Inquiry button.
Build the 3-category Mega Menus (Stationery, Note Books, Office Supplies) with rich brand tags and quick category jump links.
Create the Print & Xerox rate calculator so students and office staff can select B&W/Color Xerox, copies, lamination, and binding to see instant estimated cost.
Ensure Money Transfer is clearly labeled as an in-store counter service with receipt assistance (display/info only, no payment gateway).
Include floating Quick Contact Bar (Call, WhatsApp, Directions, Write Review) optimized for mobile and desktop shoppers.
Provide interactive Customer Reviews section with average rating (4.9/5 stars) and a working review submission form that stores reviews in MongoDB.

Create the Owner Admin Panel with password/PIN modal login. Ensure it includes full CRUD for products, low stock indicator, daily Xerox/Printing revenue logger, Recharts analytics, and Excel/PDF download functions (using openpyxl/jspdf/backend API).
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, navigation items, forms, tabs, inputs, and search fields for automated verification.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use layered depth, generous padding (p-6, p-8, p-12), and crisp borders (border-purple-100).
Use glass-morphism effects on header nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95) with high contrast purple text.
Use specific CSS transitions (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease) and do not apply universal transition: all.
Display Indian Rupee symbol '₹' cleanly on all pricing cards and calculators.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
